rows.notes: The paper is a discussion/perspective piece (Journal of Hydrology X) that reviews government reports, prior literature and the authors' own previously published methods (Bretreger et al. 2019, 2020, 2022) and proposes five 'enablers' for compliance. It reports no new data, experiment, survey or model run of its own; Table 1 is adapted from MDBA (2017b). Evidence on remote sensing managing irrigation water use or extraction dynamics is cited from other work (MDBA pilot studies, NRAR Waterbodies tool, Bretreger et al.), not produced here.

Not a primary study. The statements about NRAR using satellite datasets (DEA Waterbodies), successful prosecutions and improved transparency in NSW are drawn from government reports and media (Krause and Reinfelds 2020; NSW DPIE 2019b, 2020; Carmody 2018; Henderson 2019; McNally 2018) and summarised as Enabler #4; the paper provides no own data demonstrating that technology plus governance closed enforcement gaps.
